#641 · Cyclone Pokémon

Tornadus

Flying

Unova · Generation 5 · Legendary Pokémon

Tornadus is a Flying-type Cyclone Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 63 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (125), with a base stat total of 580.
